data: Does the blue curve have a consistently higher precision value than the red curve in both graphs?

The blue curve represents the model without pretraining, while the red curve represents the model with BiLM pretraining. In both graphs, the blue curve is consistently below the red curve across all recall values. This indicates that the blue curve has a lower precision value compared to the red curve in both datasets. Therefore, the statement "the blue curve has a consistently higher precision value than the red curve" is false.
